recentEventsByGoal.objective:
Objective: Complete safe V8 repository cleanup and prepare the active workspace for V9, achieving zero open GitHub issues and pull requests without losing unresolved requirements.

Success criteria: Re-query ddawnlll/v8 and verify zero open issues and PRs; eligible fixes are integrated on protected main; every issue and PR has an evidence-backed disposition; unresolved relevant work, blockers, source links, and acceptance criteria are preserved in docs/V9_BACKLOG.md; the active workspace is clean at the verified main SHA or a clean V9 development branch; reproducible targeted tests and one broader regression are recorded. Zero counters indicate cleanup, not resolution of deferred technical or economic questions.

Boundaries: Read the complete supplied V9 Architecture Monograph; prioritize PR #506 and reuse existing work, then address only critical V9-blocking correctness defects. Triage all issues and PRs, verify integrated main, and prepare V9 development. Do not redesign trading strategies, change existing trading defaults, conduct speculative research, consume sealed OOS, trade live, develop archived Rust, or touch prohibited legacy paths. Respect the repository's audit-mode code freeze when doing audits.

Constraints: Start four concurrent workers where supported, exclusively using the verified local DeepSeek V4.1 Flash low model identifier; never silently substitute. Agent A alone serializes PR merges; Agent B creates isolated critical fixes and regression tests; Agent C triages issues and preserves deferred requirements before closure; Agent D independently reviews and tests. No nested workers. The coordinator closes PRs that Agent A decides not to merge. Respect branch protections and required reviews; never force-push protected main, merge knowingly incorrect work, fabricate evidence, delete unique data, or alter live systems. Keep /Users/hootie/src/v8-v9 as the sole permanent active workspace; remove temporary workspaces only after safely integrating or preserving their work. Preserve historical recovery material. Apply existing repository authority and economic-claim rules.


If blocked: Continue independent safe work when permissions, mandatory review, external evidence, missing monograph, model configuration, or other hard safety restrictions block a step. Do not substitute models or bypass controls; report exact blockers and ask the owner when intervention is necessary.

=== Goal ===
Objective: Resolve and independently demonstrate the eight V8-next audit follow-ups against the current local checkout, preserving existing work and failing closed wherever evidence or authority is insufficient.

Success criteria: Verify existing fixes #1 and #8; implement and demonstrate boundary-time funding attribution without look-ahead or double counting (#2), causal funding marks with explicit coverage (#3), provenance-bound and scientifically defensible G5 selection-family control (#4), versioned nonzero finite-bootstrap reporting preserving legacy evidence (#5), verified atomic DuckDB fallback (#6), and portable active tape paths with explicit missing-data outcomes (#7). Cover all mandatory scenarios and acceptance IDs FUND-01 through REG-04 in the supplied assignment; no unavailable verification may be marked PASS.

Boundaries: Work in v8-next/ only. Preserve strategy architecture and baseline behavior except for the explicitly authorized accounting, safety, statistical, and portability corrections. No V9 changes, strategy optimization, protected OOS access, live trading, authenticated venue operations, broad rewrite, push, merge, or PR. Preserve pre-existing working-tree changes and immutable historical evidence.

Constraints: Start by recording branch, HEAD, dirty state, existing contracts and dependencies. Apply the user's D1–D5 preferred decisions unless a higher-authority contract conflicts; in that case document the conflict and fail closed. Keep receipt-time knowledge separate from economic event time, distinguish real marks from causal proxies, distinguish selection trials from stress families, version changed methodology, and never fabricate trial history or economic evidence. Use the pinned NautilusTrader version; optional DuckDB/arch installation is authorized only in the isolated development environment when supported. No unsupported economic PASS or claim.


If blocked: Continue independent work; document the exact missing evidence or contract conflict and leave affected gates BLOCKED. Ask the user only if progress requires additional authorization or a decision beyond the supplied mandate; never claim completion while required verification remains unresolved.
